name: date-picker
title: Date Picker
description: Full date-range picker UX: header with close, large range display, calendar, quick-pick preset chips (Today / Yesterday / Last 7 days / Last 30 days / This Month / Last Month / Custom), and Cancel / Confirm actions. Pixel-perfect port of Figma node 3980:641 (Pantheon › Date Picker). Drop into a BottomSheet or any modal container.
